mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with clear skies at Fireman's Park under a Waxing Gibbous moon. Tonight, the overnight low will be 50 with no rain expected. If you look up at 9:18 PM, you can catch the ISS passing high overhead, traveling from the northwest near Verona High School toward the southeast near Festival Foods.

City Hall reminds residents that road maintenance crews will begin crack filling work on September 28. While roads will stay open, please use caution in work zones, including South Nine Mound Road and North Jefferson Street.

There is plenty to do, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can check out trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus the Downtown Farmer's Market is happening at Hometown Junction Park.
On September 5, Verona officers responded to a situation where a driver was arrested for operating with a prohibited alcohol concentration after a traffic stop, citing an O W I violation.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, but we look forward to their reopening soon. They are typically open until 10:00 PM daily.
